sampling.method: op2 dense video_frames: ffmpeg accurate seek, one full-resolution PNG per requested timestamp, 6 frames from 0 to 5.0s every 1s

pixel_observations.description: Grayscale B-mode ultrasound clip of an eye on a black screen with an on-screen R EYE label at the left, a depth scale in centimetres at the right, probe/preset and gain text at the upper right, a clock with a time of day, and a site/system header strip at the top partly covered by a black masking box. A partly cut-off fragment sits in the date position beside the clock and a trailing-digits fragment sits under it. A dark rounded globe shows moving internal and lid echoes from frame to frame; no green arrow or other annotation is drawn, and no spot is clearly identifiable at this resolution.

author_context.subject: unresolved
author_context.rationale: Video S1 is the supplement named in the Results for the retrobulbar spot sign; the article does not say which patient of the nine-patient series it shows, so ownership is unresolved.

limitations: Sampled frames only; intervening frames and continuous motion were not viewed.
Whole clip is 5.995 s at 800x600; 6 frames sampled every 1 s from 0 to 5 s were all viewed at full resolution.

Burned-in text categories present: direct_identifiers (site header, masking box, partly cut-off date-position fragment, trailing-digits fragment) and timestamps_or_device_text (clock, side label, probe/preset text).
